review_type: Independent AI technical source review; not a native-speaker review

reviewed_corrections.reason: set_source clears _value_cache directly on the GUI thread before submitting replacement discovery; _apply_columns and _apply_values install plain returned dictionaries.
Any existing file with a case-insensitive .db suffix is accepted; folder forms resolve measurements.db. The revised description no longer restricts explicit filenames or claims format validation.

Single-shot QTimer is restarted on each threaded value refresh. A zero interval schedules later delivery and may combine edits before delivery; inline mode bypasses the timer as documented separately.
Does not clear row widgets before discovery. set_options appends selected values missing from current options; non-threaded JobRunner.submit invokes its callback inline.

Stops debounce, clears pending rows and calls both JobRunner.shutdown methods. Each cancels result delivery and uses a bounded deadline. drain_thread retains non-stopped thread/worker pairs in parked references.
Calls shutdown before forwarding the same event to QWidget. Revised prose avoids promising forced thread termination or immediate completion of a slow database read.
